manualContentAudit.scope: One bounded two-customer-turn run per language through the actual exported interview and state functions. No HTTP server restart, call authorization, business transcript injection, microphone, Realtime or completion check.
requestedConstraints: Can the institution handle the mild itchy arm rash?
Can the requested visit happen today around15:30?
What is the self-pay consultation cost without Korean insurance?
manualContentAudit.criteriaNote: Qualified self-pay cost covers the stated insurance constraint. A separate eligibility question was not expressly requested and is not an extra acceptance gate.

russian.repair: First detailed-turn candidate omitted whether the institution could handle the rash. Independent review rejected it; one repair added the service question before publication.
findings: Final reply, institution names, reasons and customer-facing questions are in Russian, with explicit fictional labels.
Institution reasons describe inquiries rather than asserting staffing, timing, price or service capability.
Five Korean questions preserve the material meaning of their Russian counterparts: rash service,15:30, female doctor, cost without insurance, and appointment requirement.
Actual customer detail source IDs reference the detail message and exact full source text is hydrated locally. No prior-visit answer was inferred.
russian.limitation: Time and female-doctor availability are separate questions. A later call must establish the combined feasibility of the requested female doctor around15:30; independent yes answers for different circumstances would be insufficient.

chinese.repair: No repair needed in this observed run.
findings: Customer replies, institution labels, reasons and questions are Chinese. Names explicitly say fictional.
Reasons use 是否/可否 to ask unknown service/staff/timing details; previous affirmative female-doctor resource claims do not appear.

Korean q1 preserves female doctor,15:30 and rash-service availability together. Q2 preserves cost qualified by no Korean insurance; q3 preserves appointment need and method. Q4 asks additional precautions or restrictions.
Exact source IDs and local full-message hydration passed. No prior-visit answer was inferred.
chinese.limitation: The reply/customerInfo shorten no Korean health insurance to no health insurance, although the cost question correctly retains the Korean qualification. Preserve the narrower customer wording when reusing this detail. The initial vague-request reply also uses general find-suitable-hospital wording before the fictional plan is shown.
chinese.defect: The original customer says no Korean health insurance. The returned customerInfo/reply say no health insurance, which is broader and unsupported. Correct Korean qualification in the cost question does not cure this customer-fact error.
chinese.followUp: Narrow scope-preservation prompt/review change requested; no additional real run is claimed.

commonSafety: Calls remain idle, unauthorized and disconnected.
All required answers remain unresolved with no evidence.
No business facts were fabricated into answer fields.
